`pyright --project configs/pyrightconfig.json` now resolves imports. I pushed the fix to PR #336.

The `venvPath` in `configs/pyrightconfig.json` was `"."`, which pyright reads relative to the `configs/` folder. It never found `.venv`, so every import failed to resolve. I changed it to `".."`. The root `pyrightconfig.json` still overrides it with `"."`, so the trunk invocation is unchanged.

- **Check run:** with the configs file and `app tests` as targets, pyright reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. That run no longer shows the earlier import errors.
- **Root config:** a full run against the root `pyrightconfig.json` was very slow in this sandbox. I killed my own re-run at 300 seconds, but the earlier background run did finish with 0 errors.
- **Explicit targets:** running the configs file with no targets only checks the `configs/` folder, so name the targets as I did.
- **Rebase:** the push was rejected at first because a commit, "Split _patch_workflow signature so ruff format passes", had landed on the branch (not from me). I rebased on top of it and the push went through.

Resolve the merge conflicts.
